title: Magnetic-dipole dark matter at 1 TeV: the coupling from the LZ fit and the low-energy shoulder
question: What d10^s (Anand normalisation) gives 1.0 LZ event for m = 100-4000 GeV, what magnetic moment does it correspond to, does the low-energy shoulder survive the 2024 5.4-55 keV search, and how does the contact L10 differ from photon-mediated magnetic-dipole DM?
headline_result: d10^s = 0.28 (0.15-0.43) at 1000 GeV, 0.19-0.52 for 200-4000 GeV in LZ's normalisation, which Fig. 6 confirms against the recalled Anand reduction (factor 1.96 in amplitude, 3.86 in rate, mass-independent); the 5.4-55 keV shoulder is 0.10 events in the 2024 4.2 t yr search (N_lo = 0.20), invisible for m >= 200 GeV; photon-mediated dipole DM gives N_lo = 376 and is excluded (mu <= 2e-20 e cm)
key_numbers: Fig.6 1000 GeV interval 0.171-0.614 (median 0.417); N(d10=1) LZ norm 17.6/28.7/24.5/12.9/3.63 for 100/200/400/1000/4000 GeV (ours 4.57/7.43/6.34/3.34/0.94); implied N at edges 0.38/4.85, median 2.23 vs single-count [0.105,4.36]/2.44; d10/(mv^2 mN^2)=(20.9 GeV)^-4; mu_eff(q=0.246 GeV)=2.8e-5 mu_N=2.9e-19 e cm; shoulder 0.104 (best fit), 0.50 (Fig.6 upper); tolerance 3/5/10 -> 29/48/96 ROI events; 100 GeV f_lo=0.37, 3.9 events; photon dipole N_lo 376 (charge part 18000, spin part 32), mu(1 hi event)=2.1e-5 mu_N -> 556 events in 2024 ROI
model_or_mechanism: L10 contact dipole-dipole = 4[(q^2/m_N^2)O4 - O6] pure transverse-spin q^4 Sigma' (WimPyDD); photon-mediated magnetic dipole c1,c5(1/q^2),c4,c6(1/q^2) in NREFT; Fig. 6 vector digitisation; single-count PLR reference
confidence: medium: counts/ratios/digitisation cross-checked (mass-independent implied counts, P003/P005 agreement) but absolute d10 has a factor-2 convention ambiguity and moment conversions rest on recalled reductions
